title: Fix-It Saturday
logline: Before the doors open at a neighborhood repair cafe, a hands-on coordinator films a quick, candid check-in about why {{product.name}} has earned a place in her setup routine.

lore: The Lantern Room Repair Cafe is a volunteer-run monthly gathering in a converted neighborhood firehouse. People bring ordinary belongings and learn how to mend or maintain them alongside patient volunteers.

Mara Bennett coordinates the check-in table and makes small repairs between greeting people. She started the cafe with a few neighbors after realizing that many useful things were being discarded for want of a simple fix.
The cafe runs on a paper queue, shared tools, clear explanations, and the rule that visitors do as much of the repair as they safely can themselves.
This story takes place on a busy Saturday morning just before the doors open. Mara is filming a quick personal update in the same room where the check-in table is being prepared.
